decisions.decision: Reduce Form B from ten years to five years; the FY 2015 Form Bs cover FY15 to FY19, with FY20 for other anticipated large purchases.
decisions.quote: the capital planning committee decided to reduce it to five years.

decisions.decision: Items submitted but not making the final Plan are listed in the following year only if they are still a requested item; the Committee disagrees with the Town Manager's carry-forward suggestion.
decisions.quote: the committee disagrees and wants those items listed only if they are still a requested item.

decisions.decision: The Form B is divided into Form B-1 (equipment), B-2 (technology, submitted to the IT Director and the Committee) and B-3 (buildings, maintenance and roads, coordinated with the DPW Director and/or the Director of Facilities and Grounds).
decisions.quote: the form b will become form b-1, b-2, and b-3.

decisions.decision: The Committee will hold a meeting with the IT Director when the FY 2015 packet goes out to the departments.
decisions.quote: the committee will hold a meeting with the it director when the fy 2015 packet goes out to the departments.

decisions.decision: Form D will be sent to the departments July 1, 2013, and included in the FY 2015 packet; item No. 4 will request both the budget dollar amount and the actual cost of the item.
decisions.quote: form d will be sent to the departments july 1, 2013 and also included in the packet for fy 2015.

decisions.decision: Form E, Capital Item Emergency Request, is unchanged.
decisions.quote: form e, capital item emergency request- no change.

decisions.decision: Form F, Capital Item Request Over $10,000 out of Operating Budget, Grant Monies, etc., is deleted as of this meeting.
decisions.quote: committee chose to delete form as of this meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Form F covered capital item requests over $10,000 from the operating budget, grant monies, etc., and the Committee chose to delete the form.
